caption: The Heureka XML preview lists item ID, product name, image, price with VAT and SKU per product; the shop name, shop address and image path are hidden.
The feed went Live with 12 products and 18 variants, but with 5 unlisted, 36 warnings and no shopping service that had opened it yet. Feed link, domain and store name are hidden.
The warnings explained: out of stock products drop out, and products need a standardized product type and must be published to the Online Store. Domain and store name are hidden.
The Free plan stops at 100 products, 300 variants, one market, one language and one feed; our store used 14 products and 23 variants. The store name is hidden.
Basic is $9.99 and Advanced $19.99 a month, both with a 7 day trial; Basic lifts the limit to 1,000 products and 5 feeds and adds markets and translations. The store name is hidden.
Approving Basic: $9.99 every 30 days after a trial to 24 Nov, and Approve stays grey until a payment method is added. We did not approve; the store name is hidden.
